pages.title: Farmstead utilities
pages.lede: Small Farmstead server mods for NeoForge 1.21.1: each one does one job and players do not need it on the client.

pages.title: Farmstead Chunk Breeding Limit
pages.lede: An animal cap per chunk or per Farmstead Claims region: no new baby appears once the cap is reached.

pages.title: Farmstead Trade Chat
pages.lede: A trade channel in the main chat: a message starting with @ goes to everyone with the channel tag ([Торговля] by default).
